ns1:item.ns1:title: Using Rock-Eval pyrolysis to measure biochar carbon stability
ns1:item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 01 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00841-8

Monica McCall explains how the stable and labile fractions of carbon in biochar can be characterized using Rock-Eval pyrolysis.
ns1:item.dc:title: Using Rock-Eval pyrolysis to measure biochar carbon stability
ns1:item.dc:creator: Monica McCall

ns1:item.ns1:title: Importance, drivers and trends of inland water greenhouse gas emissions
ns1:item.content:encoded:
Nature Reviews Earth & Environment, Published online: 30 September 2026; doi:10.1038/s43017-026-00818-7

This Review provides a detailed summary of global CO₂, CH₄ and N₂O emissions from inland waters. The authors map emission hot spots, assess anthropogenic drivers and historical increases, evaluate contributions to continental GHG budgets and discuss future trajectories of inland water GHG emissions.
